conditions.runtime: One universal Settlements implementation on logical integrated/dedicated servers; exact town/resident/native-content admission retained. change.summary: Remove resident filter/sort controls and their unused branching; retain live search and automatic name ordering, preserving payroll access in recruit detail.

modifiers.before: Resident filter cycles all/villagers/guards/needs/profession/legacy roles; sort state holds unreachable alternate branches. Mockup also shows a By name control.
modifiers.after: One live search field, complete matching roster, deterministic case-insensitive name order, no All residents or By name buttons or resident filtering controller.

modifiers.before: Roster payroll action is available only behind the guards filter.
modifiers.after: Same global payroll request and confirmation available from the roster whenever debt exists, even without a visible recruit, plus split/compact recruit detail; active only with unpaid payroll and no pending request. Existing server authorization, debt, funding and payment semantics unchanged.

rationale.purpose: Remove controls the user does not want without hiding residents or losing the existing payroll action.
rationale.decision_source: User2026-10-20 explicitly requests removing All residents and By name from GUI and code.
rationale.user_requested: Remove these controls and their resident navigation code.
rationale.codex_choices: Preserve automatic name ordering and live search; place global debt payment in recruit detail using the unchanged authoritative request. Food catalogue filtering is outside this request and remains.
